title: A rod in a stronger field
hook: Change magnetic-field magnitude and predict motional emf magnitude.
misconception: motional emf magnitude stays fixed when magnetic-field magnitude doubles.
objective: Apply emf = BLv to compare motional emf magnitude when magnetic-field magnitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a rod of fixed length moving perpendicular to its length and the field at fixed speed, emf = BLv. When magnetic-field magnitude doubles, motional emf magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model emf = BLv; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a rod of fixed length moving perpendicular to its length and the field at fixed speed, with a nonzero initial result. If magnetic-field magnitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on motional emf magnitude?
recall.why: Apply emf = BLv under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
